name: Inventory Slot Icons
description: Transparent, monochrome line-art icons for body slots and inventory UI states.
positive: Readable at 32x32: a single centred symbol, clean monochrome warm-grey line art with one consistent dark outline, flat two-tone interior, generous transparent padding, no colour accent, no background, silhouette first.
negative: Do not use text, labels, backgrounds, drop shadows, gradients, multiple objects, coloured fills, or thin broken lines.
